implementation_notes: PactSwift provides the Swift DSL and runs the mock service in-process: a MockService(consumer:provider:) is created per suite, uponReceiving/given(ProviderState(...))/withRequest(method:path:)/willRespondWith(status:headers:body:) declare one interaction with matchers (Matcher.SomethingLike, Matcher.EachLike, Matcher.RegexLike, Matcher.FromProviderState) and example generators, and mockService.run(timeout:) { url, done in ... } hands the mock URL to the client under test while the request is asserted and the interaction finally completes through done(). It implements Pact Specification v3, covers iOS consumer tests plus provider verification on macOS and Linux, and on Linux needs a compatible libpact_ffi shared library on the search path.
pitfalls: Forgetting to call done() times out the test even when the assertions passed, and calling it before the assertions finish reports failures against the wrong interaction.
On Linux a compatible libpact_ffi build must be on LD_LIBRARY_PATH (or in /usr/local/lib); a mismatched .so fails at load time rather than with a contract error.
Client code must accept the mock base URL; an endpoint compiled into the client either hits the real service or never matches the recorded interaction.
